en.heading: Contract tests on log schemas
paragraphs: Log pipelines that accept arbitrary JSON become PII sinks within a few releases. Publish an explicit schema for LLM trace events: allowed keys, maximum payload sizes, and typed identifiers instead of free-text user fields. Enforce the contract in continuous integration with golden fixtures so a new field cannot merge without privacy review.

Keep structured telemetry separate from debug dumps. OpenTelemetry spans should carry model version, token counts, and correlation identifiers while prompts live in a redacted side channel with stricter access controls. When validation fails at ingest, drop the payload and increment a metric rather than writing to an ungoverned fallback topic.

Schedule quarterly audits that diff production schemas against the documented allowlist. Drift often arrives through log forwarders and vendor agents that remap fields silently. Treat schema divergence as a release blocker for AI features, the same way you would for authentication middleware regressions. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

en.heading: Map controls to published standards
paragraphs: Privacy programs require traceability from logged fields to legal basis and retention class. Maintain a data dictionary that links each LLM log attribute to OWASP LLM risks and your DPIA outcomes. Engineers should answer auditor questions without ad hoc chat archaeology across half the company.

Redaction must be deterministic and unit tested. Regular-expression lists belong in version control with fixtures on representative payloads, including multilingual personal names and formatted national identifiers. Sampling rates change during incidents; redaction rules should not depend on operator memory. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Bulk export and notebook rehydration paths need the same controls as the primary store. Federated analytics tools replicate logs into regions counsel never approved. Block cold-archive reads without break-glass roles that expire automatically and emit security alerts. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

tr.heading: Log şemalarında sözleşme testleri
paragraphs: Keyfi JSON kabul eden log hatları birkaç release içinde PII birikimine dönüşür. LLM trace olayları için açık bir şema yayınlayın: izinli anahtarlar, maksimum yük boyutları ve serbest metin kullanıcı alanları yerine tipli tanımlayıcılar. Altın fixture'larla CI'da şemayı zorunlu kılın; gizlilik incelemesi olmadan yeni alan merge edilemesin.

Yapılandırılmış telemetriyi debug dökümlerinden ayırın. OpenTelemetry span'leri model sürümü, token sayıları ve korelasyon kimliklerini taşısın; prompt'lar daha sıkı erişim kontrollü redakte yan kanalda kalsın. Ingest'te doğrulama başarısız olursa yükü düşürün ve yönetimsiz yedek konuya yazmak yerine metrik artırın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Üretim şemalarını dokümante allowlist ile çeyreklik karşılaştırın. Sapma çoğu zaman alanları sessizce yeniden eşleyen forwarder ve satıcı ajanlarıyla gelir. Şema ayrışmasını, kimlik doğrulama middleware gerilemelerinde olduğu gibi AI özellikleri için release engeli sayın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

tr.heading: Kontrolleri yayımlanmış standartlara bağlayın
paragraphs: Gizlilik programları, loglanan alanların hukuki dayanak ve saklama sınıfına izlenebilirliğini ister. Her LLM log özniteliğini OWASP LLM riskleri ve DPIA sonuçlarınıza bağlayan bir veri sözlüğü sürdürün. Mühendisler denetçi sorularını şirketin yarısında geçmiş sohbet aramadan yanıtlamalı. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Redaksiyon deterministik ve birim testli olmalı. Regex listeleri sürüm kontrolünde kalsın; çok dilli kişi adları ve biçimlendirilmiş ulusal kimlikler dahil temsili yüklerle test edin. Olay sırasında örnekleme oranları değişir; redaksiyon kuralları operatör hafızasına bağlı olmamalı. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Toplu export ve notebook yeniden yükleme yolları birincil depo ile aynı kontrollere tabi olmalı. Federasyonlu analitik araçları logları avukatların onaylamadığı bölgelere kopyalar. Soğuk arşiv okumalarını otomatik süresi dolan break-glass rolleri ve güvenlik uyarıları olmadan engelleyin. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

de.heading: Vertragstests für Log-Schemata
paragraphs: Pipelines, die beliebiges JSON akzeptieren, werden innerhalb weniger Releases zu PII-Senken. Veröffentlichen Sie ein explizites Schema für LLM-Trace-Events: erlaubte Keys, maximale Payload-Größen und typisierte Identifikatoren statt Freitext-Nutzerfelder. Erzwingen Sie den Vertrag in CI mit Golden Fixtures, damit ohne Privacy-Review kein neues Feld gemergt wird. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Trennen Sie strukturierte Telemetrie von Debug-Dumps. OpenTelemetry-Spans tragen Modellversion, Token-Zähler und Korrelations-IDs; Prompts liegen in einem redigierten Side-Channel mit strengeren ACLs. Schlägt die Validierung beim Ingest fehl, verwerfen Sie die Payload und erhöhen Sie eine Metrik statt in ein ungoverned Fallback-Topic zu schreiben. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Planen Sie vierteljährliche Audits, die Produktionsschemata mit der dokumentierten Allowlist vergleichen. Drift kommt oft über Forwarder und Vendor-Agenten, die Felder still umbenennen. Behandeln Sie Schema-Abweichung als Release-Blocker für KI-Features wie Auth-Middleware-Regressionen. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

de.heading: Controls an veröffentlichte Standards koppeln
paragraphs: Privacy-Programme verlangen Rückverfolgbarkeit von Log-Feldern zu Rechtsgrundlage und Retention-Klasse. Pflegen Sie ein Data Dictionary, das jedes LLM-Log-Attribut mit OWASP-LLM-Risiken und DPIA-Ergebnissen verknüpft. Engineers sollen Auditor-Fragen ohne Ad-hoc-Chat-Archäologie beantworten. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Redaction muss deterministisch und unit-getestet sein. Regex-Listen gehören ins Repo mit Fixtures für mehrsprachige Namen und formatierte nationale IDs. Sampling-Raten ändern sich in Incidents; Redaction-Regeln dürfen nicht vom Operator-Gedächtnis abhängen. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Bulk-Export und Notebook-Rehydration brauchen dieselben Controls wie der Primärspeicher. Föderierte Analytics kopieren Logs in Regionen, die Legal nie freigegeben hat. Blockieren Sie Cold-Archive-Reads ohne Break-Glass-Rollen mit Auto-Expiry und Security-Alerts. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

fr.heading: Tests de contrat sur les schémas de logs
paragraphs: Les pipelines qui acceptent du JSON arbitraire deviennent des puits de PII en quelques releases. Publiez un schéma explicite pour les traces LLM : clés autorisées, tailles maximales et identifiants typés plutôt que champs utilisateur en texte libre. Faites respecter le contrat en CI avec des fixtures dorées pour empêcher tout nouveau champ sans revue privacy.

Séparez la télémétrie structurée des dumps de debug. Les spans OpenTelemetry portent version de modèle, compteurs de tokens et IDs de corrélation ; les prompts restent dans un canal latéral redigé avec ACL plus strictes. Si la validation échoue à l'ingest, droppez la charge et incrémentez une métrique au lieu d'écrire dans un topic de repli non gouverné.

Planifiez des audits trimestriels comparant les schémas prod à l'allowlist documentée. La dérive arrive souvent via des forwarders et agents vendor qui renomment des champs silencieusement. Traitez la divergence de schéma comme un bloqueur de release pour les features IA, comme pour une régression middleware d'authentification.

fr.heading: Relier les contrôles aux standards publiés
paragraphs: Les programmes privacy exigent la traçabilité des champs loggés vers base légale et classe de rétention. Maintenez un dictionnaire de données liant chaque attribut LLM aux risques OWASP LLM et à vos DPIA. Les ingénieurs doivent répondre aux auditeurs sans archéologie ad hoc dans les chats de l'entreprise.

La redaction doit être déterministe et testée unitairement. Les listes regex vivent dans le VCS avec des fixtures sur des payloads représentatifs, noms multilingues et identifiants nationaux formatés. Les taux d'échantillonnage changent en incident ; les règles ne doivent pas dépendre de la mémoire des opérateurs.

Les exports bulk et chemins de rehydratation notebook exigent les mêmes contrôles que le store primaire. Les outils analytics fédérés répliquent des logs dans des régions jamais approuvées par le juridique. Bloquez la lecture d'archives froides sans rôles break-glass expirant automatiquement et alertes sécurité. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

it.heading: Contract test sugli schemi di log
paragraphs: Pipeline che accettano JSON arbitrario diventano sink di PII in pochi release. Pubblicate uno schema esplicito per eventi trace LLM: chiavi ammesse, dimensioni massime del payload e identificatori tipizzati al posto di campi utente in testo libero. Enforzate il contratto in CI con golden fixture così nessun campo nuovo merge senza privacy review.

Separate telemetria strutturata da dump di debug. Gli span OpenTelemetry portano versione modello, conteggi token e ID di correlazione; i prompt restano in un side channel redatto con ACL più rigide. Se la validazione fallisce in ingest, scartate il payload e incrementate una metrica invece di scrivere su un topic di fallback non governato.

Pianificate audit trimestrali che diffano schemi di produzione con l'allowlist documentata. Il drift arriva spesso da forwarder e agent vendor che rimappano campi in silenzio. Trattate la divergenza di schema come release blocker per feature AI, come per regressioni del middleware di autenticazione. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

it.heading: Allineare i controlli agli standard pubblicati
paragraphs: I programmi privacy richiedono tracciabilità dai campi loggati a base legale e classe di retention. Mantenete un data dictionary che lega ogni attributo log LLM ai rischi OWASP LLM e alle vostre DPIA. Gli engineer devono rispondere agli auditor senza archeologia ad hoc nelle chat aziendali.

La redazione deve essere deterministica e coperta da unit test. Le liste regex stanno nel VCS con fixture su payload rappresentativi, nomi multilingue e identificativi nazionali formattati. I tassi di campionamento cambiano durante gli incident; le regole non devono dipendere dalla memoria degli operatori. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Export bulk e reidratazione notebook richiedono gli stessi controlli dello store primario. Strumenti analytics federati replicano log in regioni mai approvate dal legale. Bloccate letture da archivi cold senza ruoli break-glass con scadenza automatica e alert di sicurezza. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

zh.heading: 日志 schema 的契约测试
paragraphs: 接受任意 JSON 的日志管道会在几个发布周期内变成 PII 汇聚点。为 LLM trace 事件发布显式 schema：允许字段、最大 payload、用类型化标识符替代自由文本用户字段。在 CI 用 golden fixture 强制执行契约，未经隐私评审不得合并新字段。
结构化遥测与 debug 转储分离。OpenTelemetry span 携带模型版本、token 计数与 correlation ID；prompt 放在 ACL 更严的脱敏侧通道。ingest 校验失败时丢弃 payload 并递增指标，不要写入未治理的回退 topic。
按季度审计生产 schema 与文档 allowlist 的差异。漂移常来自 silently 重映射字段的 forwarder 与厂商 agent。将 schema 偏离视为 AI 功能的发布阻断项，与认证中间件回归同级。

zh.heading: 对照公开标准落地控制
paragraphs: 隐私项目要求日志字段可追溯到法律依据与保留等级。维护数据字典，把每个 LLM 日志属性关联 OWASP LLM 风险与 DPIA 结论。工程师应能回答审计问题，而不必在全公司聊天记录里考古。
脱敏必须确定且可单测。正则列表纳入版本库，用多语言姓名、格式化证件号等代表性 payload 做 fixture。事故期间采样率会变；脱敏规则不能依赖值班人员记忆。
批量导出与 notebook 回灌路径需与主存储同等控制。联邦分析工具会把日志复制到法务未批准的区域。禁止在无自动过期 break-glass 角色与安全告警的情况下读取冷归档。

ja.heading: ログスキーマの契約テスト
paragraphs: 任意 JSON を受け入れるパイプラインは数リリースで PII の溜まり場になる。LLM trace イベント向けに明示スキーマを公開し、許可キー、最大ペイロード、自由テキストの代わりに型付き識別子を使う。golden fixture で CI 強制し、プライバシーレビューなしの新フィールド merge を防ぐ。
構造化テレメトリと debug ダンプを分離する。OpenTelemetry span はモデル版、トークン数、相関 ID を載せ、プロンプトは ACL の厳しい redacted サイドチャンネルに置く。ingest 検証失敗時はペイロードを捨て、未統制フォールバック topic へ書かずメトリクスを増やす。
四半期ごとに本番スキーマと文書化 allowlist を diff 監査する。ドリフトはフィールドを静かに付け替える forwarder やベンダーエージェント経由で入ることが多い。スキーマ乖離は AI 機能のリリースブロッカーとし、認証 middleware 退行と同格に扱う。

ja.heading: 公開標準にコントロールを対応付ける
paragraphs: プライバシープログラムはログフィールドから法的根拠と保持クラスへのトレーサビリティを求める。各 LLM ログ属性を OWASP LLM リスクと DPIA 結果に結ぶデータ辞書を維持する。エンジニアは社内チャット発掘なしで監査人の質問に答えられるべきだ。
redaction は決定的で単体テスト可能であること。regex リストは VCS に置き、多言語名や整形された国民 ID を含む代表ペイロードで fixture する。インシデント中はサンプリング率が変わる。redaction 規則をオペレータ記憶に依存させない。
一括 export と notebook 再水和経路はプライマリストアと同じ統制が要る。連合 analytics は法務未承認リージョンへログを複製する。自動失効 break-glass ロールとセキュリティアラートなしのコールドアーカイブ読取を遮断する。

en.heading: Split budgets by traffic class
paragraphs: Marketing landing pages and authenticated application shells rarely share the same critical path. Assign separate performance budgets for static hero routes, logged-in dashboards, and API-backed widgets so one team's experiment cannot consume another team's latency envelope. Document owners in the same service catalog entry you use for on-call routing.

Budgets should name the metric, the percentile, and the geography. A p75 Largest Contentful Paint target in Frankfurt does not transfer to São Paulo without CDN evidence. Tie regressions to deployment metadata so you can distinguish bundle growth from upstream saturation or DNS misconfiguration during cutovers.

Review budget burn in product forums, not only frontend guild meetings. When product managers see weekly trend lines beside feature velocity, they negotiate scope before shipping another carousel or third-party tag manager snippet. Performance becomes a planning input instead of a post-release fire drill. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

en.heading: Instrument against documented baselines
paragraphs: Synthetic monitors and lab Lighthouse runs disagree when authentication, feature flags, or consent banners differ from production. Align probes with real client headers, cookie policies, and edge caching rules your marketing stack actually emits. Otherwise budgets green-light merges that fail under real user conditions. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Use HTTP caching semantics deliberately on marketing assets while keeping hashed filenames immutable. Misapplied Cache-Control on HTML shells creates stale campaign messaging; overly short TTL on static chunks recreates unnecessary origin load. RFC guidance helps engineers argue with ad-tech vendors using shared vocabulary. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Publish which budgets gate merges versus which only page owners. Hard gates belong on routes that drive revenue or signup completion; informational budgets can warn on editorial pages without blocking the train. Clarity prevents alert fatigue and keeps rollback conversations focused on user-visible regressions. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

tr.heading: Trafik sınıfına göre bütçe ayırın
paragraphs: Pazarlama landing sayfaları ile kimliği doğrulanmış uygulama kabukları nadiren aynı kritik yolu paylaşır. Statik hero rotalar, giriş yapılmış panolar ve API destekli widget'lar için ayrı performans bütçeleri tanımlayın; bir ekibin deneyi diğerinin gecikme payını tüketmesin. Sahipleri on-call yönlendirmesinde kullandığınız servis kataloğu kaydında belgeleyin. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Bütçeler metrik, yüzdelik dilim ve coğrafya adını taşımalı. Frankfurt'ta p75 LCP hedefi CDN kanıtı olmadan São Paulo'ya taşınmaz. Gerilemeleri deployment metadata'ya bağlayın; bundle büyümesi ile cutover sırasındaki upstream doygunluğu veya DNS yanlış yapılandırmasını ayırın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Ürün yöneticileri haftalık trendleri feature hızının yanında görünce, bir carousel veya üçüncü taraf tag manager eklemeden kapsam pazarlığı yapar. Performans release sonrası yangın tatbikatı değil planlama girdisi olur. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

tr.heading: Dokümante edilmiş baz çizgilere göre enstrümante edin
paragraphs: Sentetik monitörler ile lab Lighthouse, kimlik doğrulama, feature flag veya onay banner'ları üretimden farklıysa ayrışır. Probeleri pazarlama yığınının gerçekten gönderdiği istemci başlıkları, çerez politikaları ve edge önbellek kurallarıyla hizalayın. Aksi halde bütçeler gerçek kullanıcı koşullarında çöken merge'lere yeşil ışık yakar. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Pazarlama varlıklarında HTTP önbellekleme semantiğini bilinçli kullanın; hash'lenmiş dosya adları değişmez kalsın. HTML kabuklarında yanlış Cache-Control bayat kampanya mesajı üretir; statik parçalarda aşırı kısa TTL gereksiz origin yükü yaratır. RFC rehberi mühendislerin ad-tech satıcılarıyla ortak sözcük dağarcığıyla tartışmasını sağlar. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Hangi bütçelerin merge'i durdurduğunu, hangilerinin yalnızca sahipleri uyardığını yayınlayın. Sert kapılar gelir veya kayıt tamamlamayı taşıyan rotalarda olmalı; bilgilendirici bütçeler editoryal sayfalarda treni durdurmadan uyarabilir. Netlik uyarı yorgunluğunu azaltır, rollback konuşmalarını kullanıcıya görünen gerilemelere odaklar. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

de.heading: Budgets nach Traffic-Klasse trennen
paragraphs: Marketing-Landingpages und authentifizierte App-Shells teilen selten denselben Critical Path. Weisen Sie getrennte Performance-Budgets für statische Hero-Routen, eingeloggte Dashboards und API-Widgets zu, damit ein Team-Experiment nicht das Latenz-Budget eines anderen verbraucht. Dokumentieren Sie Owner im selben Service-Katalogeintrag wie für On-Call-Routing. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Budgets benennen Metrik, Perzentil und Geografie. Ein p75-LCP-Ziel in Frankfurt gilt ohne CDN-Evidenz nicht in São Paulo. Koppeln Sie Regressionen an Deployment-Metadaten, um Bundle-Wachstum von Upstream-Sättigung oder DNS-Fehlkonfiguration bei Cutovers zu trennen. Wenn Product Manager wöchentliche Trends neben Feature-Velocity sehen, verhandeln sie Scope, bevor ein weiteres Karussell oder Tag-Manager-Snippet shipped wird. de.heading: Gegen dokumentierte Baselines instrumentieren
paragraphs: Synthetische Monitore und Lab-Lighthouse divergieren, wenn Auth, Feature Flags oder Consent-Banner von Prod abweichen. Richten Sie Probes auf echte Client-Header, Cookie-Policies und Edge-Caching-Regeln Ihres Marketing-Stacks aus. Sonst grünen Budgets Merges, die unter Real-User-Bedingungen scheitern. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Nutzen Sie HTTP-Caching bewusst für Marketing-Assets, während gehashte Dateinamen immutable bleiben. Falsch gesetztes Cache-Control auf HTML-Shells erzeugt veraltete Kampagnen; zu kurze TTL auf statischen Chunks erzeugt unnötige Origin-Last. RFC-Leitfaden hilft Engineers, mit Ad-Tech-Vendors in gemeinsamer Terminologie zu diskutieren. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Veröffentlichen Sie, welche Budgets Merges blockieren versus nur Owner paginieren. Harte Gates gehören auf Umsatz- oder Signup-Routen; informative Budgets können redaktionelle Seiten warnen ohne den Train zu stoppen. Klarheit verhindert Alert-Müdigkeit und fokussiert Rollbacks auf sichtbare Regressionen. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

fr.heading: Scinder les budgets par classe de trafic
paragraphs: Les landing marketing et les shells applicatives authentifiées partagent rarement le même chemin critique. Attribuez des budgets performance séparés aux routes hero statiques, tableaux de bord connectés et widgets API pour qu'une expérience d'équipe ne consomme pas l'enveloppe de latence d'une autre. Documentez les owners dans la même fiche catalogue de service que le routage on-call.

Les budgets nomment métrique, percentile et géographie. Un objectif LCP p75 à Francfort ne se transpose pas à São Paulo sans preuve CDN. Liez les régressions aux métadonnées de déploiement pour distinguer croissance de bundle, saturation amont ou mauvaise config DNS lors des bascules. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Revoyez la consommation de budget en forums produit, pas seulement en guilde frontend. Quand les PM voient des tendances hebdo à côté de la vélocité feature, ils négocient le scope avant un carrousel ou un snippet tag manager. La perf devient une entrée de planification, pas une drill post-release.

fr.heading: Instrumenter selon des baselines documentées
paragraphs: Moniteurs synthétiques et Lighthouse lab divergent si auth, feature flags ou bandeaux consentement diffèrent de la prod. Alignez les sondes sur les en-têtes client, politiques cookies et règles edge cache réellement émis par votre stack marketing. Sinon les budgets valident des merges qui échouent en conditions utilisateur réelles.

Employez la sémantique HTTP cache délibérément sur les assets marketing tout en gardant des noms hashés immuables. Un Cache-Control mal appliqué sur les coques HTML fige des messages campagne ; un TTL trop court sur chunks statiques recharge l'origine inutilement. Le RFC aide à discuter avec les vendors ad-tech dans un vocabulaire partagé.

Publiez quels budgets bloquent les merges versus lesquels paginent seulement les owners. Les gates durs appartiennent aux routes revenu ou inscription ; les budgets informatifs peuvent avertir sur pages éditoriales sans stopper le train. La clarté réduit la fatigue d'alerte et centre les rollbacks sur régressions visibles.

it.heading: Separare i budget per classe di traffico
paragraphs: Landing marketing e shell applicative autenticate condividono raramente lo stesso critical path. Assegnate budget performance distinti a route hero statiche, dashboard loggati e widget API così un esperimento di team non consuma l'envelope di latenza di un altro. Documentate gli owner nella stessa voce catalogo servizi usata per il routing on-call.

I budget devono nominare metrica, percentile e geografia. Un obiettivo LCP p75 a Francoforte non si trasferisce a San Paolo senza evidenza CDN. Collegate le regressioni ai metadati di deploy per separare crescita del bundle da saturazione upstream o DNS errato durante i cutover. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Rivedete il consumo budget nei forum prodotto, non solo nella guild frontend. Quando i PM vedono trend settimanali accanto alla velocity feature, negoziano scope prima di shipparre un altro carosello o snippet tag manager. La performance diventa input di pianificazione, non drill post-release. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

it.heading: Strumentare rispetto a baseline documentate
paragraphs: Monitor sintetici e Lighthouse da lab divergono se auth, feature flag o banner consenso differiscono dalla prod. Allineate le sonde a header client, policy cookie e regole edge cache che lo stack marketing emette davvero. Altrimenti i budget approvano merge che falliscono in condizioni utente reali.

Usate deliberatamente la semantica HTTP cache sugli asset marketing mantenendo nomi hash immutabili. Cache-Control errato sulle shell HTML crea messaggi campagna obsoleti; TTL troppo breve su chunk statici ricarica l'origine inutilmente. La guida RFC aiuta a discutere con vendor ad-tech in vocabolario condiviso. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Pubblicate quali budget bloccano merge e quali paginano solo gli owner. Gate duri appartengono a route revenue o completamento signup; budget informativi possono avvisare su pagine editoriali senza fermare il train. Chiarezza riduce alert fatigue e concentra rollback su regressioni visibili. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

zh.heading: 按流量类型拆分预算
paragraphs: 营销落地页与已登录应用壳层很少共享同一关键路径。为静态 hero 路由、登录仪表盘与 API 小组件分别设定性能预算，避免一个团队的实验耗尽另一团队的延迟额度。在与 on-call 路由相同的服务目录条目中记录负责人。
预算应写明指标、分位数与地域。p75 LCP 目标在法兰克福成立，不代表圣保罗无需 CDN 证据。将回归关联部署元数据，以区分 bundle 膨胀、上游饱和与切换期 DNS 误配。
在产品评审而非仅前端例会中查看预算消耗。PM 在功能速度与周趋势并列时，会在再上加 carousel 或第三方 tag manager 前协商范围。性能成为规划输入，而非发布后救火。

zh.heading: 对照文档化基线做观测
paragraphs: 当认证、特性开关或同意横幅与生产不一致时，合成监控与实验室 Lighthouse 会分歧。探针应对齐营销栈实际发送的客户端头、Cookie 策略与边缘缓存规则。否则预算会为真实用户条件下失败的合并开绿灯。
营销资源 deliberate 使用 HTTP 缓存语义，同时保持哈希文件名不可变。HTML 壳层 Cache-Control 误用会导致活动文案过期；静态 chunk TTL 过短则徒增源站负载。RFC 指引帮助工程师与 ad-tech 厂商用共同词汇讨论。
公开哪些预算阻断合并、哪些仅 paging 负责人。硬门禁应放在收入或注册完成路径；告知性预算可在编辑页告警而不阻断发布列车。清晰边界减少告警疲劳，使回滚讨论聚焦用户可见回归。

ja.heading: トラフィッククラスごとに予算を分割
paragraphs: マーケ LP と認証済みアプリシェルは同じクリティカルパスを共有しにくい。静的 hero ルート、ログイン後ダッシュボード、API ウィジェットで性能予算を分け、一チームの実験が他チームのレイテンシ枠を食い尽くさないようにする。on-call ルーティングと同じサービスカタログ項目にオーナーを記載する。
予算は指標、パーセンタイル、地域を明示する。フランクフルトの p75 LCP 目標は CDN 根拠なしにサンパウロへは移植できない。回帰はデプロイメタデータに結び、バンドル増大とカットオーバー時の upstream 飽和や DNS 誤設定を切り分ける。
予算消費はフロントエンドギルドだけでなくプロダクトフォーラムでレビューする。PM が機能速度の横に週次トレンドを見れば、追加カルーセルや tag manager スニペット前にスコープ交渉が起きる。性能は計画入力となり、リリース後の火消しではなくなる。

ja.heading: 文書化ベースラインに沿って計測
paragraphs: 認証、feature flag、同意バナーが本番と異なると合成監視と lab Lighthouse は乖離する。プローブをマーケスタックが実際に出すクライアントヘッダ、Cookie 方針、エッジキャッシュ規則に合わせる。さもなければ予算が実ユーザー条件で失敗する merge を通してしまう。
マーケアセットでは HTTP キャッシュ意味論を意図的に使い、ハッシュファイル名は不変に保つ。HTML シェルの Cache-Control 誤りは古いキャンペーン文言を固定し、静的 chunk の短 TTL は origin 負荷を増やすだけだ。RFC ガイドは ad-tech ベンダーとの共通語彙議論に役立つ。
どの予算が merge を止め、どれが owner ページングのみかを公開する。ハードゲートは収益や signup 完了ルートに置く。情報的予算は編集ページで警告しつつトレインは止められる。明確さがアラート疲労を減らし、ロールバック議論をユーザー可視回帰に集中させる。

en.heading: Structure pages for durable queries
paragraphs: Editorial briefings rank when they answer decision questions with stable URLs, not when they chase hourly keywords. Lead with a concise thesis, explicit scope, and dated context so readers know whether the page still applies. Wire-style headlines rot quickly; briefing architecture should survive news cycles without constant slug churn.

Internal linking should connect briefings to primary sources, product documentation, and related explainers you control. Avoid orphan pages that exist only for campaigns. Search engines reward coherent topic clusters where each node adds vocabulary and depth instead of repeating the same press release phrasing. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Measure success with engagement on briefing templates separately from conversion funnels. Time on page, scroll depth on methodology sections, and return visits indicate trust. Treat those signals as editorial KPIs alongside rankings so teams do not optimize titles for clicks while eroding credibility. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

en.heading: Ship structured data that matches reality
paragraphs: Rich results require JSON-LD that reflects visible content, not boilerplate FAQ blocks pasted for snippets. Validate markup in staging with the same components production renders, including paywalls, consent gates, and lazy-loaded sections that crawlers might otherwise miss. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Article schema should include author, dateModified, and headline fields aligned with on-page semantics. Mismatch between structured data and HTML triggers manual review in search quality systems. Prefer conservative markup over speculative types your legal team has not approved. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

International briefings need hreflang and translation parity on section structure, not just swapped titles. Google Search Central documentation describes how language variants should reference each other. Broken alternates dilute authority across locales you invested in translating. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

tr.heading: Kalıcı sorgular için sayfa yapısı
paragraphs: Editoryal brifingler, saatlik anahtar kelimeleri kovaladığında değil karar sorularını sabit URL'lerle yanıtladığında sıralanır. Kısa tez, açık kapsam ve tarihli bağlamla başlayın; okuyucu sayfanın hâlâ geçerli olup olmadığını anlasın. Ajans tarzı manşetler hızla bayatlar; brifing mimarisi sürekli slug değiştirmeden haber döngülerini atlatsın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

İç linkleme brifingleri birincil kaynaklara, ürün dokümantasyonuna ve kontrol ettiğiniz ilgili açıklamalara bağlamalı. Yalnızca kampanyalar için var olan yetim sayfalardan kaçının. Arama motorları, her düğümün basın bülteni cümlelerini tekrarlamak yerine kelime dağarcığı ve derinlik eklediği tutarlı konu kümelerini ödüllendirir. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

tr.heading: Gerçeğe uyan yapılandırılmış veri gönderin
paragraphs: Zengin sonuçlar, snippet için yapıştırılmış kalıp SSS blokları değil görünür içeriği yansıtan JSON-LD ister. Staging'de üretimin render ettiği bileşenlerle işaretlemeyi doğrulayın; paywall, onay kapıları ve crawler'ların kaçırabileceği lazy bölümler dahil. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Article schema yazar, dateModified ve manşet alanlarını sayfa içi semantikle hizalamalı. Yapılandırılmış veri ile HTML uyumsuzluğu arama kalite sistemlerinde manuel incelemeyi tetikler. Hukuk ekibinizin onaylamadığı spekülatif tipler yerine muhafazakâr işaretleme tercih edin. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

de.heading: Seiten für dauerhafte Queries strukturieren
paragraphs: Redaktionelle Briefings ranken, wenn sie Entscheidungsfragen mit stabilen URLs beantworten, nicht wenn sie stündliche Keywords jagen. Führen Sie mit These, klarem Scope und datiertem Kontext, damit Leser erkennen, ob die Seite noch gilt. Draht-Schlagzeilen altern schnell; Briefing-Architektur soll News-Zyklen ohne ständigen Slug-Wechsel überstehen. Interne Verlinkung verbindet Briefings mit Primärquellen, Produktdoku und erklärenden Seiten unter Ihrer Kontrolle. Vermeiden Sie Waisen-Seiten nur für Kampagnen. Suchmaschinen belohnen kohärente Topic-Cluster, in denen jeder Knoten Vokabular und Tiefe statt Pressemitteilungs-Phrasen liefert. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Behandeln Sie diese Signale als redaktionelle KPIs neben Rankings, damit Teams nicht Klick-Titel optimieren und Glaubwürdigkeit erodieren. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

de.heading: Structured Data liefern, das der Realität entspricht
paragraphs: Rich Results brauchen JSON-LD, das sichtbaren Content widerspiegelt, nicht Boilerplate-FAQ-Blöcke für Snippets. fr.heading: Structurer les pages pour des requêtes durables
paragraphs: Les briefings éditoriaux rankent quand ils répondent à des questions de décision avec des URL stables, pas en chassant des mots-clés horaires. Ouvrez avec une thèse concise, un périmètre explicite et un contexte daté pour que le lecteur sache si la page reste valide. Les titres fil de presse vieillissent vite ; l'architecture briefing doit survivre aux cycles news sans churn de slug constant.

Le maillage interne relie briefings, sources primaires, doc produit et explainers que vous contrôlez. Évitez les pages orphelines créées seulement pour campagnes. Les moteurs récompensent des clusters cohérents où chaque nœud enrichit vocabulaire et profondeur au lieu de répéter le wording communiqué de presse. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Mesurez le succès sur les templates briefing séparément des entonnoirs conversion. Temps passé, profondeur de scroll sur méthodologie et retours signalent la confiance. Traitez ces signaux comme KPI éditoriaux aux côtés des rankings pour éviter d'optimiser titres au clic tout en érodant la crédibilité. fr.heading: Publier des données structurées conformes au contenu
paragraphs: Les résultats enrichis exigent du JSON-LD reflétant le contenu visible, pas des blocs FAQ génériques collés pour snippets. Validez le markup en staging avec les mêmes composants que la prod, paywalls, consent gates et sections lazy que les crawlers pourraient manquer. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Le schema Article doit aligner auteur, dateModified et headline avec la sémantique on-page. Un décalage structured data / HTML déclenche revue manuelle dans les systèmes qualité search. Préférez un markup conservateur aux types spéculatifs non approuvés par le juridique. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Les briefings internationaux exigent hreflang et parité de structure de sections, pas seulement titres traduits. it.heading: Strutturare pagine per query durature
paragraphs: I briefing editoriali rankano quando rispondono a domande decisionali con URL stabili, non inseguendo keyword orarie. Aprite con tesi concisa, scope esplicito e contesto datato così il lettore capisce se la pagina resta valida. I titoli stile wire invecchiano in fretta; l'architettura briefing deve sopravvivere ai cicli news senza churn continuo di slug.

Il linking interno collega briefing a fonti primarie, documentazione prodotto ed explainer sotto controllo. Evitate pagine orfane solo per campagne. I motori premiano cluster coerenti dove ogni nodo aggiunge vocabolario e profondità invece di ripetere frasi da comunicato stampa. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Misurate il successo sui template briefing separatamente dai funnel di conversione. Tempo on page, scroll depth sulle sezioni metodologia e visite di ritorno indicano fiducia. Trattate questi segnali come KPI editoriali accanto ai ranking così i team non ottimizzano titoli per click erodendo credibilità. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

it.heading: Pubblicare structured data allineati alla realtà
paragraphs: I rich result richiedono JSON-LD che rifletta contenuto visibile, non blocchi FAQ boilerplate incollati per snippet. Preferite markup conservativo a tipi speculativi non approvati dal legale. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

zh.heading: 为长期查询设计页面结构
paragraphs: 编辑简报要在稳定 URL 上回答决策问题才会获得排名，而不是追逐 hourly 关键词。以简洁论点、明确范围与 dated 上下文开篇，让读者判断页面是否仍适用。通讯社式标题很快过期；简报架构应跨新闻周期而无需频繁改 slug。
内链应把简报连到一手来源、产品文档及你们掌控的相关解读页。避免仅为 campaign 存在的孤儿页。搜索引擎奖励连贯主题簇，其中每个节点增加词汇与深度，而非重复新闻稿措辞。
在简报模板上单独衡量成功，与转化漏斗分开。停留时间、方法论区块滚动深度与回访表明信任。把这些信号与排名并列为编辑 KPI，避免团队为点击优化标题而损害可信度。

zh.heading: 发布与真实内容一致的结构化数据
paragraphs: 富结果需要反映可见内容的 JSON-LD，而非为 snippet 粘贴的模板 FAQ。在 staging 用与生产相同的组件验证 markup，包括 paywall、同意门与爬虫可能错过的懒加载区块。
Article schema 的 author、dateModified、headline 应与页面语义一致。结构化数据与 HTML 不一致会在搜索质量系统中触发人工审核。优先保守 markup，而非法务未批准的推测类型。

ja.heading: 持続的クエリ向けのページ構造
paragraphs: 編集ブリーフィングは時間単位キーワードを追うより、安定 URL で意思決定質問に答えると順位を得やすい。簡潔な論旨、明示スコープ、日付付き文脈で始め、読者がページの現 validity を判断できるようにする。ワイヤー見出しは速く陳腐化する。ブリーフィング設計は slug  churn なしにニュースサイクルを超えるべきだ。
内部リンクはブリーフィングを一次ソース、製品ドキュメント、自社 explainer に結ぶ。キャンペーン専用の孤児ページを避ける。検索エンジンは各ノードがプレス文句を反復せず語彙と深さを足す一貫トピッククラスタを評価する。
成功はコンバージョンファネルと分け、ブリーフィングテンプレートで測る。滞在時間、方法論セクションのスクロール深度、再訪は信頼の指標。クリック向けタイトル最適化で信頼を削らないよう、これらをランキング横の編集 KPI とする。

ja.heading: 実態に合う structured data を出荷する
paragraphs: リッチ結果には可視コンテンツを反映する JSON-LD が要る。snippet 用の定型 FAQ ブロックではない。staging で本番と同コンポーネントで markup を検証し、paywall、同意ゲート、クローラが逃しうる lazy セクションも含める。

en.heading: Treat eval datasets as versioned code

Ogni pagina runbook richiede segnali osservabili: error budget su latenza gateway, risultati retrieval vuoti, tassi violazione policy e anomalie costo. Collegate dashboard con filtri precompilati per il tier servizio owner del feature. Minuti a indovinare il grafico giusto diventano downtime visibile al cliente. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

I template comunicazione cliente differiscono per classe. Outage modello può giustificare banner stato; misconfig retrieval può richiedere fix silenzioso senza promettere capacità mai esistite. Legale e support pre-approvino tier di wording così i commander non redigono claim nuovi alle tre di notte. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

it.heading: Esercitare i controlli citati nel runbook
paragraphs: Kill switch route modello, feature flag accesso tool e override rate-limit falliscono in silenzio senza test mensili. La guida incident Google SRE enfatizza mitigazione praticata sull'improvvisazione eroica. Pianificate game day che flip switch in staging poi prod in finestre basso traffico con rollback verificato. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

I post-incident devono aggiornare casi eval automatizzati e sonde, non solo wiki. I playbook PagerDuty raccomandano artefatti timeline; specchiate con PR che codificano lezioni come gate CI. Altrimenti lo stesso schermo retrieval vuoto torna il trimestre dopo con nuova roster on-call. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Collegare alert billing e quota alla stessa rotazione quando feature AI possono spike spend. Incident costo sono incident disponibilità per startup con cap vendor rigidi. Documentate chi autorizza aumenti temporanei limite e come auditare dopo. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

zh.heading: 分页前先分类故障模式
paragraphs: AI 产品事故混合模型 outage、检索索引滞后、被误判为 bug 的安全拒绝，以及在 partial JSON 上失败的客户端流式解析器。runbook 应以决策树开篇，区分 provider 错误与应用回归，避免 on-call 在压力下 rollback 错误层。
每个 runbook 页需要可观测信号：gateway 延迟 error budget、空检索结果、策略违规率与成本异常。链接预填过滤器的 dashboard 到特性所属服务层。猜测哪张图重要所耗分钟会变成用户可见 downtime。
客户沟通模板因类别而异。模型 outage 可能需要状态横幅；检索误配或需静默修复，而不承诺产品从未具备的能力。法务与支持应预先批准 wording 层级，避免 incident commander 凌晨三点起草新声明。

zh.heading: 演练 runbook 引用的控制措施
paragraphs: 模型路由 kill switch、tool 访问 feature flag 与 rate-limit  override 若未每月测试会静默失效。Google SRE 事故指南强调演练过的缓解而非英雄式即兴。安排 game day 在 staging 然后低流量窗口 prod 切换，并验证 rollback。
事后回顾必须更新自动化 eval 用例与探针，而非仅 wiki。PagerDuty 响应手册建议捕获时间线 artefact；以 PR 将教训编码为 CI gate 来镜像该纪律。否则下一季度新 on-call  roster 仍会看到相同空白检索屏。
当 AI 功能可能 spike 支出时，将账单与 quota 告警接入同一 rotation。对 vendor 硬上限的初创公司，成本事故即可用性事故。记录谁可授权临时提限及事后如何审计。

ja.heading: ページング前に故障モードを分類
paragraphs: AI プロダクトインシデントはモデル outage、retrieval インデックス遅延、バグと誤認される安全拒否、部分 JSON で落ちるクライアント streaming パーサーが混ざる。runbook は provider エラーとアプリ回帰を分ける決定木から始め、プレッシャー下で間違った層を rollback しない。
各 runbook ページに observables が要る。gateway レイテンシ error budget、空 retrieval 結果、policy 違反率、コスト異常。機能オーナーのサービス tier 向けにフィルタ済み dashboard をリンクする。正しいグラフ当てに費やす分が顧客可視 downtime になる。
顧客通信テンプレートはクラスで異なる。モデル outage は status バナーが正当化されうる。retrieval 誤設定は黙って直し、もともと存在しない能力を約束しない。法務と support が wording tier を事前承認し、夜中三点に新 claim を書かせない。

ja.heading: runbook が参照する制御を演習する
paragraphs: モデルルート kill switch、tool アクセス feature flag、rate-limit override は月次テストなしでは静かに失敗する。Google SRE インシデント指針は即興より訓練された mitigation を強調する。低トラフィック窓で staging から prod へ switch を切る game day を計画し rollback を検証する。
post-incident は wiki だけでなく自動 eval ケースと probe を更新する。PagerDuty playbook は timeline 成果物を推奨する。教訓を CI gate として PR に書き込む。さもなければ同じ空白 retrieval 画面が四半期後に新 on-call roster で戻る。
AI 機能が spend を spike しうるとき billing と quota アラートを同じ rotation に配線する。ベンダー hard cap のスタートアップではコスト incident は可用性 incident だ。一時 limit 引上げを誰が承認し事後監査するか文書化する。

en.heading: Design keys for agent retry semantics
paragraphs: Language-model agents retry tool calls when responses truncate, gateways time out, or orchestrators restart mid-flight. Side effects such as payments, ticket creation, and inventory holds must accept an idempotency key scoped to the logical operation, not merely the HTTP request identifier regenerated on each attempt.

Persist keys with the tool invocation ledger: model turn, tool name, normalized arguments hash, and tenant identifier. Memory-only deduplication collapses when workers scale horizontally. The ledger becomes the audit trail finance and support query during duplicate charge investigations. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Define expiration policies per tool class. Read-only fetches can drop keys quickly; monetary transfers may retain them for days to match processor reconciliation windows. Document which tools are never safe to retry without human confirmation in the same runbook entry on-call reads. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

en.heading: Align HTTP and application layers
paragraphs: Stripe documents idempotent POST semantics with a client-supplied key header; mirror that pattern on internal tool gateways even when backends are not card processors. RFC 9110 describes safe and idempotent HTTP methods—use that vocabulary when debating whether GET-style tools should mutate state. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Return consistent response bodies on replay so agents do not misinterpret a duplicate as a new success with different identifiers. Integration tests should deliver the same payload twice and assert single side effect counters increment once. Chaos tests that kill workers mid-request expose gaps unit tests miss.

Expose metrics on duplicate suppressions versus genuine failures. Silent drops hide misconfigured keys; loud failures teach agents to halt rather than loop. Dashboards should segment by tool and tenant to detect abusive retry storms early. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

tr.heading: Agent yeniden deneme semantiği için anahtar tasarlayın
paragraphs: Dil modeli agent'ları yanıt kesildiğinde, gateway zaman aşımında veya orchestrator uçuş ortasında yeniden başladığında tool çağrılarını yeniden dener. Ödeme, ticket açma ve stok tutma gibi yan etkiler, her denemede yenilenen HTTP istek kimliği değil mantıksal işleme kapsamlı idempotency key kabul etmeli. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Anahtarları tool çağrı defteriyle kalıcı tutun: model turu, tool adı, normalize argüman hash'i ve tenant kimliği. Yalnızca bellekte deduplication yatay ölçeklenince çöker. Defter, mükerrer ücret soruşturmalarında finans ve desteğin baktığı denet izidir. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Tool sınıfına göre sona erme politikası tanımlayın. Salt okunur fetch'ler anahtarları hızlı bırakabilir; parasal transferler işlemci mutabakat pencerelerine uymak için günlerce saklayabilir. İnsan onayı olmadan asla yeniden denenmemesi gereken tool'ları on-call runbook kaydında belgeleyin. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

tr.heading: HTTP ve uygulama katmanlarını hizalayın
paragraphs: Stripe, istemci tarafı key başlığıyla idempotent POST semantiğini dokümante eder; arka uç kart işlemcisi olmasa bile iç tool gateway'lerinde aynı kalıbı yansıtın. RFC 9110 güvenli ve idempotent HTTP metotlarını tanımlar; GET tarzı tool'ların durum değiştirip değiştirmemesi tartışmasında bu sözcüğü kullanın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Yeniden oynatmada tutarlı gövde dönün; agent mükerreri farklı kimlikli yeni başarı sanmasın. Entegrasyon testleri aynı yükü iki kez iletsin, yan etki sayaçlarının bir kez arttığını assert etsin. Worker'ı istek ortasında öldüren kaos testleri birim testlerinin kaçırdığı boşlukları gösterir. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

Mükerrer bastırmalar ile gerçek hataları metrikleyin. Sessiz düşüşler yanlış yapılandırılmış anahtarları gizler; gürültülü hatalar agent'a döngü yerine durmayı öğretir. Dashboard'lar tool ve tenant'a göre segmentleyerek agresif retry fırtınalarını erken yakalasın. Bunu bir sonraki prodüksiyon incelemenizde tekrar ele alın, sahip atayın ve tarihli bir iyileştirme ticket'ı bağlayın.

paragraphs: LLM-Agenten retried Tool-Calls bei Trunkierung, Gateway-Timeouts oder Orchestrator-Neustarts mid-flight. Side Effects wie Zahlungen, Tickets und Inventory-Holds müssen Idempotency Keys pro logischer Operation akzeptieren, nicht nur pro HTTP-Request-ID, die bei jedem Versuch neu entsteht. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Persistieren Sie Keys im Tool-Invocation-Ledger: Model-Turn, Tool-Name, normalisierter Argument-Hash und Tenant-ID. Memory-only-Deduplication bricht bei horizontaler Skalierung. Das Ledger ist Audit-Trail für Finance und Support bei Duplicate-Charge-Untersuchungen. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an. Definieren Sie Ablauf pro Tool-Klasse. Read-only Fetches können Keys schnell verwerfen; Geldtransfers behalten sie tagelang für Processor-Reconciliation. Dokumentieren Sie Tools, die ohne Human Confirmation nie retry-safe sind, im selben Runbook-Eintrag wie On-Call. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

de.heading: HTTP- und Anwendungsschicht ausrichten
paragraphs: Stripe dokumentiert idempotente POST-Semantik mit Client-Key-Header; spiegeln Sie das auf internen Tool-Gateways auch ohne Card-Processor-Backend. RFC 9110 beschreibt safe und idempotente HTTP-Methoden—nutzen Sie dieses Vokabular in Debatten, ob GET-artige Tools State mutieren dürfen. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Liefern Sie bei Replay konsistente Response Bodies, damit Agenten Duplikate nicht als neuen Erfolg mit anderen IDs missinterpretieren. Integrationstests senden dieselbe Payload zweimal und asserten einmaligen Side-Effect-Counter. Chaos-Tests, die Worker mid-request killen, zeigen Lücken jenseits Unit-Tests. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

Metriken zu unterdrückten Duplikaten versus echten Failures exposen. Stille Drops verbergen falsch konfigurierte Keys; laute Failures lehren Agenten Halt statt Loop. Dashboards segmentieren nach Tool und Tenant für abusive Retry-Storms. Prüfen Sie dies im nächsten Produktionsreview, setzen Sie einen Owner und hängen Sie ein datiertes Remediation-Ticket an.

fr.heading: Concevoir des clés pour la sémantique retry agent
paragraphs: Les agents LLM retentent appels outils quand réponses tronquent, gateways timeout ou orchestrateurs redémarrent en vol. Effets de bord paiements, tickets et réserves stock doivent accepter clé idempotence scope opération logique, pas seulement identifiant requête HTTP régénéré à chaque tentative. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Persistez clés avec ledger invocation outil : tour modèle, nom outil, hash arguments normalisés et identifiant tenant. Déduplication mémoire seule s'effondre à l'échelle horizontale. Le ledger devient piste audit finance et support lors d'enquêtes double débit. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Définissez expiration par classe d'outil. Fetch read-only peut jeter clés vite ; transferts monétaires les gardent jours pour fenêtres réconciliation processeur. Documentez outils jamais safe à retry sans confirmation humaine dans la même entrée runbook on-call. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

fr.heading: Aligner couches HTTP et application
paragraphs: Stripe documente POST idempotent avec en-tête clé client ; miroitez ce pattern sur gateways outils internes même sans backend processeur cartes. RFC 9110 décrit méthodes HTTP safe et idempotentes—utilisez ce vocabulaire pour débattre si outils style GET mutent l'état. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Retournez corps réponse cohérents au replay pour que agents ne lisent pas duplicate comme nouveau succès aux identifiants différents. Tests intégration livrent deux fois même payload et assertent compteurs effet de bord incrémentés une fois. Tests chaos tuant workers mid-request exposent gaps unitaires. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

Exposez métriques suppressions duplicate versus échecs réels. Drops silencieux cachent clés mal configurées ; échecs bruyants apprennent aux agents arrêt plutôt boucle. Dashboards segmentent par outil et tenant pour détecter tempêtes retry abusives. Revoyez ceci au prochain production review, nommez un owner et rattachez un ticket de remédiation daté.

it.heading: Progettare chiavi per semantica retry agent
paragraphs: Gli agent LLM ritentano tool call quando risposte troncano, gateway vanno in timeout o orchestrator ripartono a metà volo. Side effect pagamenti, ticket e hold inventario devono accettare chiave idempotenza scoped all'operazione logica, non solo ID richiesta HTTP rigenerato a ogni tentativo. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Persistete chiavi con ledger invocazione tool: turn modello, nome tool, hash argomenti normalizzati e identificativo tenant. Deduplicazione solo in memoria collassa scalando orizzontalmente. Il ledger è audit trail per finance e support nelle indagini addebiti duplicati. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Definite scadenza per classe tool. Fetch read-only possono scartare chiavi presto; trasferimenti monetari possono tenerle giorni per finestre riconciliazione processor. Documentate tool mai safe da ritentare senza conferma umana nella stessa voce runbook on-call. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

it.heading: Allineare layer HTTP e applicazione
paragraphs: Stripe documenta semantica POST idempotente con header chiave client; replicate il pattern su gateway tool interni anche senza backend card processor. RFC 9110 descrive metodi HTTP safe e idempotenti—usate quel vocabolario nel dibattito se tool stile GET mutano stato. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Restituite body coerenti al replay così gli agent non interpretano duplicato come nuovo successo con ID diversi. Test integrazione inviano stesso payload due volte e assertano contatori side effect incrementati una volta. Test chaos che killano worker mid-request espongono gap oltre unit test. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

Esporre metriche su soppressioni duplicate versus failure reali. Drop silenziosi nascondono chiavi mal configurate; failure rumorosi insegnano agli agent halt invece di loop. Dashboard segmentano per tool e tenant per rilevare tempeste retry abusive. Rivedetelo nel prossimo production review, assegnate un owner e collegate un ticket di remediation datato.

zh.heading: 为 agent 重试语义设计键
paragraphs: 当响应截断、gateway 超时或 orchestrator 中途重启时，语言模型 agent 会重试 tool 调用。支付、建单与库存 hold 等副作用必须接受绑定逻辑操作的幂等键，而非每次尝试重新生成的 HTTP 请求 ID。
将键与 tool 调用账本一并持久化：模型轮次、tool 名、规范化参数哈希与 tenant 标识。仅内存去重在水平扩展时会崩溃。账本是财务与支持在重复扣费调查中的审计轨迹。
按 tool 类定义过期策略。只读 fetch 可快速丢弃键；资金转移可能保留数日以匹配处理器对账窗口。在 on-call 同一 runbook 条目中记录绝不可在无人工确认下重试的 tool。

zh.heading: 对齐 HTTP 与应用层
paragraphs: Stripe 文档说明带客户端键头的幂等 POST 语义；即使后端非卡处理器，内部 tool gateway 也应镜像该模式。RFC 9110 描述安全与幂等 HTTP 方法——在争论 GET 式 tool 是否应改状态时使用该词汇。
重放时返回一致响应体，避免 agent 将重复误判为不同标识的新成功。集成测试应两次投递相同 payload 并断言副作用计数仅增一次。在请求中途 kill worker 的 chaos 测试暴露单元测试遗漏。
暴露重复抑制与真实失败的指标。静默丢弃掩盖键配置错误；显式失败教会 agent 停止而非循环。dashboard 按 tool 与 tenant 分段以早期发现滥用重试风暴。

ja.heading: agent リトライ意味論向けキー設計
paragraphs: LLM agent は応答 truncate、gateway タイムアウト、オーケストレータ mid-flight 再起動で tool call をリトライする。決済、チケット作成、在庫 hold など副作用は各試行で再生成される HTTP リクエスト ID ではなく論理操作スコープの idempotency key を受け入れる必要がある。
キーを tool 呼び出し ledger と共に永続化する。モデル turn、tool 名、正規化引数ハッシュ、tenant ID。メモリのみ dedupe は水平スケールで崩れる。ledger は二重課金調査で finance と support が見る監査 trail になる。
tool クラスごとに失効方針を定義する。read-only fetch はキーを早く捨てられる。金銭 transfer は processor  reconciliation 窓に合わせ数日保持しうる。human confirmation なしでは決して retry safe でない tool を on-call runbook 同一項目に記載する。

ja.heading: HTTP とアプリケーション層を整合
paragraphs: Stripe はクライアント供給キーヘッダ付き idempotent POST 意味論を文書化する。バックエンドが card processor でなくても内部 tool gateway で同パターンを mirror する。RFC 9110 は safe と idempotent HTTP メソッドを述べる。GET 風 tool が state を mutate してよいか議論でその語彙を使う。

replay で一貫 response body を返し、agent が duplicate を別 ID の新成功と誤読しないようにする。integration test は同一 payload を二度送り side effect カウンタが一度だけ増えることを assert する。mid-request で worker を kill する chaos test が unit test の gap を露わにする。
duplicate 抑制と genuine failure のメトリクスを expose する。silent drop は misconfigured key を隠す。loud failure は agent に loop より halt を教える。dashboard は tool と tenant で segment し abusive retry storm を早期検知する。

en.heading: Probe the same path production uses
paragraphs: Health checks that hit admin bypass URLs green-light dashboards while customers queue behind rate limits and OAuth failures. Synthetic probes should authenticate like real clients, traverse the same edge routes, and submit prompts sized like production percentiles. Blackbox-style exporters help when you need TLS and DNS validation from outside your cluster.

Separate liveness from quality. A two-hundred response with empty completions still violates user expectations. Store probe transcripts in an isolated bucket with short retention so monitoring does not feed training loops or leak prompt templates into analytics warehouses. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Run probes from multiple regions and providers to catch DNS and peering issues single-region metrics miss. Correlate probe failures with vendor status pages but trust your own signals when partial outages affect only certain model routes. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

en.heading: Alert on latency and drift before hard outages
paragraphs: Time-to-first-token rising while error rates stay flat often precedes saturation incidents. OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI describe attributes you can attach to spans emitted by probe clients, making gateway regressions visible in the same backends SRE already watches. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Rotate a small library of probe prompts designed to detect format regressions and safety filter changes, not only HTTP five-hundred responses. Compare embeddings or structured outputs against baselines when deterministic text match is too brittle across model updates. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

Tune alert routing so probe noise pages the gateway owner, not every model consumer team. Document escalation when probes fail but manual spot checks succeed—that usually indicates feature-flag skew or canary cohort mismatch rather than false positives. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket.

tr.heading: Üretimin kullandığı yolu probelayın
paragraphs: Admin bypass URL'lerine vuran health check'ler müşteriler rate limit ve OAuth hatalarında beklerken dashboard'ları yeşil gösterir. Sentetik probeler gerçek istemciler gibi kimlik doğrulamalı, aynı edge rotalarından geçmeli ve üretim yüzdeliklerine uygun boyutta prompt göndermeli. Blackbox tarzı exporter'lar cluster dışından TLS ve DNS doğrulaması gerektiğinde yardım eder.

Canlılığı kaliteden ayırın. Boş completion'lı iki yüzlü yanıt yine kullanıcı beklentisini ihlal eder.
